subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Study of sound and sound waves
solution:
The correct answer is: Acoustics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Acoustics"** refers to the science concerned with the study of sound and sound waves. (ध्वनिकी)
 
• **"Acoustics" **is the branch of physics that deals with the study and understanding of sound, including its production, transmission, and effects.
 
 
• **Example: **The engineer specialized in **acoustics **to improve the sound quality of the auditorium.
 
 
 
• Hence, the one-word substitute for the study of sound and sound waves is **'Acoustics'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Botany **(वनस्पति विज्ञान): The scientific study of plants.

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to pursue a career in **botany **to explore the diverse plant species in tropical rainforests.
 
 
 
• **Physics **(भौतिकी ): The natural science that involves the study of matter, its motion, and behaviour through space and time.
 
 
• **Example: Physics **explains how gravity works and why objects fall to the ground.
 
 
 
• **Demography** (जनसांख्यिकी): The statistical study of populations, especially human beings.
 
 
• **Example:** The **demography **of the region has changed significantly over the past decade due to migration.
